title: 26th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/26/2/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 20/2/2025 to 22/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of three members to the Civil Service Commission under Article 180(b) of the Constitution and Article 13 of the Civil Service Act (Law No. 5/2007) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on the President's nomination of two members to the Human Rights Commission under Article 190(b) of the Constitution.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on its review of the Insurance Bill.
Report of the Public Finance Committee on the Bill amending the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, sent the President's Civil Service Commission nominees to committee, and took up committee reports on Human Rights Commission nominees, the Insurance Bill and the National Payment System Act amendment.
